detail: Bounded May-July 2025 SOXL green-candle micro-target grid frozen before execution.
512/512 cells; zero profitable at 2bp or 5bp cost.
Gross edge was tiny: 29/256 positive at zero cost and 1/256 at 1bp.
Canonical quote lake had zero SOXL rows; no strategy interpretation.
User narrowed remote quote repair to May only; partial cache preserved.
May SIP bid-cross fills reached 59%-79% within 1-5m, but net was -8.41%/-5.87%/-7.16% because forced exits lost 34-67bp on average.
Literal 1:1 stopped 91.36% in median 25.8ms because 5.93bp target/stop distance equaled the 5.93bp spread; net -6.11% with 1bp stop slippage.
0/15 wider symmetric OCO cells profitable; target rates remained far below 50%, so market-buy 1:1 family rejected.
